name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Groups related buttons into one control, or joins a main action with its options as a split button.

name: button
title: Button
description: Starts an action on this page or submits a form.

name: close-button
title: Close button
description: The icon-only button that closes a dialog, sheet, banner or panel, named "Close" in the current language.

name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Keeps one task reachable over scrolling content, as a button or a link, collapsing to its icon on phones.

name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Pick files with a button or by dropping them, validate size and type, and show each file with its progress or error.

name: link-button
title: Link button
description: A link that looks like a button: a call to action that goes to another page.

name: link
title: Link
description: Text that goes to another page, inline in running text or as a standalone subtle link.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme toggle
description: Lets people choose system, light or dark theme, stored per device and applied before first paint.

name: toggle-button
title: Toggle button
description: A button that stays pressed or not, alone or in a group where one or several options are on.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or a company shown by photo, initials or icon, alone or in a stacked group.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A count or an unread dot next to a label or on an icon.

name: card
title: Card
description: A surface that groups related content about one object, optionally a link or a button as a whole.

name: heading
title: Heading
description: A page or section title on the type scale, with its HTML level separate from its size.

name: icon
title: Icon
description: Draws any Lucide icon by name, sized and colored with theme tokens.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as a keycap in help text, menus and tooltips.

name: lozenge
title: Lozenge
description: A short status word in a colored pill, one meaning per tone.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A region that scrolls inside a height limit with thin themed scrollbars, keyboard reachable.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: A thin line between groups that spacing alone does not separate, optionally with a short label.

name: text
title: Text
description: Body copy, captions and inline text on the type scale, plus Prose for long rich text.
